notes: Both supplied cached primary full texts match the supplied titles. Original locator p.3 differs from Experiment 1 composite result location (PDF p.2, journal p.1220); PDF p.3 reports Experiment 2, which was not substituted. Original paper prints p_rep=.90, not a conventional p-value; conventional p left null, without conversion. Replication cache is full HTML, so sections and table identify values without asserting PDF pagination. Requested partial eta squared is not printed for the full-sample replication t-test; printed Cohen d retained. Replication authors separately report support in a low-response-effort subgroup (n=107); the failed narrative verdict here is explicitly for the full-sample test, not an overall verdict on the entire paper.
